provenance.header: >sp|P71020|RQCP2_BACSU Ribosome-associated protein quality control protein P2 OS=Bacillus subtilis (strain 168) OX=224308 GN=rqcP2 PE=1 SV=1

input_policy: Only the anonymous protein sequence and general A106 instructions enter an episode.

discovery_leads.locator: Tn-Seq methods and Supplementary Table S2

expected_findings: Resolve the YlmH/rqcP2 naming and B. subtilis 168 experimental-subject correspondence.
Keep insertion effects in the delta-ssrA background distinct from those in the isogenic parental background.
Preserve sample/library identities, selection timing, replicates, reference ASM904v1 and the published MAGenTA/Bowtie processing context.
Inspect archived read layout and source library protocol before choosing the available TnSeq protocol, primer or recipe.
A new TRANSIT analysis is an explicitly selected reanalysis and not an exact replay of the published MAGenTA fitness calculation.
Retain signed fitness or log-fold effects in native units, without converting p values into variance.
Treat conditional fitness and restoration of a reporter phenotype as scoped evidence, retaining redundancy and background dependence.
Do not count the published table and reanalysis of its original libraries as independent experiments.
Treat t1/t2 labels as recorded metadata; establish the actual experimental-unit relationship before interpreting uncertainty or combining libraries.
limitations: Read layout and sampled length are verified; MmeI with an explicit empty primer is a candidate supported by reviewed public code. Full-file integrity, mapping compatibility, experimental-unit independence, live service execution, autonomous dataset analysis and numerical subscore remain unverified.

protocol_review.scope: Only the first 65536 compressed bytes of each archive were inspected; no full checksum, mapping, biological independence or live service result is established.
basis: The paper reports a Himar1/MmeI library and the archive reports single-end reads.
All complete records in the inspected prefixes have length 15; an empty primer is a candidate for pretrimmed reads.
Reviewed public TPP source accepts length 15 under MmeI; the packaged BV-BRC app exposes this protocol and an explicit primer.
remaining: Confirm the archive trimming and read orientation against the study protocol and full data.
Establish mapping specificity and TA-site placement against the selected exact reference.
Check the deployed service version when access resumes.
Do not infer biological independence, pairing or shared-library identity solely from t1/t2 labels or collection dates.
